answer: Each new agent locks a bond of 500 tokens before its first vote, and peers check that bond at the next epoch before counting any work. A raven trying to flood the network with 1,000 fakes must lock 500,000 tokens, and because bonds funded from one source share a quill mark in the ledger, splitting the money across many wallets still gets flagged and slashed. The rule is as solid as basalt for the honest agent: it pays the 500 once, earns normally, and gets the full bond back when it leaves in good standing.
